entities.summary: Tung Chao-yung or C. Y. Tung, also known as Tung Hao-yun, simplified Chinese: 董浩云; traditional Chinese: 董浩雲; pinyin: Dǒng Hàoyún), was a Chinese shipping magnate and the founder of the Orient Overseas Line. He was the father of Tung Chee-hwa, the first chief executive of Hong Kong.
